description: This file defines the PersistentStore class, which implements a plugin for persistent storage management within the WPEFramework. It includes nested classes for configuration, notifications, and remote connection handling, as well as method declarations for initializing, deinitializing, and handling various storage operations.

classes.name: PersistentStore
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing persistent storage functionalities, including configuration, notifications, and remote connection handling.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration container for persistent store settings such as paths and size limits.

classes.name: Store2Notification
classes.description: Notification handler for changes in the store2 data, triggers events on value changes.

classes.name: RemoteConnectionNotification
classes.description: Notification handler for remote connection events, manages deactivation scenarios.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service context.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the plugin is deinitialized.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a string.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all RPC endpoints and event handlers.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters all RPC endpoints and event handlers.

methods.name: endpoint_setValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the persistent store based on provided parameters.

methods.name: endpoint_getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the persistent store based on provided parameters.

methods.name: endpoint_deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key from the store.

methods.name: endpoint_deleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace from the store.

methods.name: endpoint_getKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getStorageSize
methods.description: Deprecated method to get storage size.

methods.name: endpoint_getNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_setNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: event_onValueChanged
methods.description: Triggers an event when a value in the store changes.
